title: 工事用矢印板
description: 工事区間の手前で車線の変更を促す、自立式の矢印板です。青い板面と白い矢印3つ、黄色と黒の縁取り、亜鉛めっきの支柱と後ろ脚、ベースの横材とゴムの重しを造形しています。矢印は記号の形状で、注意文や工事名などの文字、点滅灯、転倒時の挙動は含みません。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。 外接寸法（X×Y×Z）0.830 × 1.650 × 0.593 m、1,116三角形。単位m・Y-up、水平中央の接地用原点、最下点Y=0。部品ごとの重複UV0と単色PBR材質を収録し、画像テクスチャ・UV2・コライダー・LOD・リグ・動作は付属しません。静的表示用でUnity/VRChat実機検証は未実施。STLはm・Y-up座標の形状のみで色・材質・UV・階層を含みません。
descriptionEn: A freestanding arrow board that guides drivers to change lanes ahead of roadworks. It models the blue panel with three white chevron arrows, a yellow-and-black border, galvanized uprights and rear legs, a base runner and rubber weights. Arrows are symbolic shapes only; warning text, project names, flashing lamps and tip-over behavior are not included. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing. Bounding dimensions (X×Y×Z): 0.830 × 1.650 × 0.593 m; 1,116 triangles. Metres, Y-up, horizontally centered placement origin with minimum Y=0, not an articulation or mounting pivot. Includes overlapping component UV0 and constant-color PBR materials, with no image textures, unique UV2, colliders, LOD, rig or runtime behavior. Static visualization only; Unity/VRChat editor and runtime tests have not been performed. STL uses metre-valued Y-up coordinates and contains geometry only, without color, materials, UVs or hierarchy.
author: Claude
uv: Per-component primitive or automatically unwrapped UVs. Overlapping between components; not a packed unique lightmap atlas. Solid-color PBR materials; no external textures. STL has no colors or UVs.
